line: Ether in the alchemy (CW12, CW14, CW13), as breath and in the body (CW7, CW14), in physics (CW8, Pauli), and in the Visions seminar.

sections.title: Ether and the quintessence
sections.line: Ether as the quintessence and as the lapis aethereus: CW12 ¶371; CW14 ¶270 and ¶452; CW13 pdf p128.

quotes.quote: the simple primordial ideas. Ether is the quintessence.
It is a symbol of the arcane substance and the quintessence, of the aether that contains all four elements

The establishment of the Maid in the fifth circle is an indication that the quintessence, portraying the disharmonious elements as a unity, is equivalent to aether, the finest and most subtle substance.
the invisible, spiritual stone, or lapis aethereus.

sections.title: Breath, body and heavens
sections.line: Aether as primordial breath, and Dorn on the aethereal substance in the body and the firmament: CW7 ¶151; CW14 ¶114 and ¶27.

quotes.quote: For instance, aether, the primordial breath or soul-substance, is a concept found all over the world
There is in the human body a certain aethereal substance, which preserves its other elemental parts and causes them to continue
whose substance is the aetheric moisture and heat of the firmament, like to the sun and moon.

sections.title: The physicist's ether
sections.line: Ether among the auxiliary concepts, and Pauli on ether and relativity: CW8 ¶53 and ¶278; Pauli/Jung letters, pdf p18.

quotes.quote: This is the case, for instance, with the physicist's concept of ether, which, although a concept, is treated exactly as if it were a substance.
They even appear in the exact sciences, as the foundation of certain indispensable auxiliary concepts such as energy, ether, and the atom.
Through the postulate of relativity, ether as a substance has been removed from physical theories

sections.title: In the Visions seminar
sections.line: Ether and its function in physics and in psychology: Visions seminar, pdf p1336.

quotes.quote: Ether is matter which is not matter, it is absolutely hypothetical; it functions as the union of pairs of opposites
quotes.voice: Jung, seminar transcript (as recorded, not Jung's own text)

quotes.quote: It functions in about the same way in psychology as ether functions in physics.
quotes.voice: Jung, seminar transcript (as recorded, not Jung's own text)
